title: trig events
author: irpina
description: The Octatrack's trig dispatch as an event: the moment the frame interrupt hands a track's trig to its machine, so mods that need a trig's own moment (a trig mute, a sidechain, a meter) combine. A handler sees the audio track and may veto the trig, so the machine never starts it. With no handler subscribed it costs a few instructions at each trig; from 0.2 it also tells the mods of STOP's tail kill, the moment the unit holds a track's effect tails (ev_tail_kill), and on its own it changes nothing the unit does.
